title: ui(grid): the whole-set footer and group aggregations send a raw sum over a record-mode quantity the engine now refuses (unit twin of #32334)
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibvMi1U7R2kBd3JbTPu

Filing gate: ① a product defect with a named landing and a named producer · Source: fleet (L1 7062716121 on PR #36060, R2 item 1)

## 维护者速读
- 问题：PR #36060 让引擎拒绝「不按单位分组就求和」的按行单位数量（例如一行 10 千克、一行 10 磅）。列表和表格底部的合计行会把所有列的合计放进同一个查询，它只跳过按行币种的金额，不认识按行单位的数量。
- 影响：一旦带单位的数量字段上线，某列底部选了合计，整条合计查询就被拒，其他列的合计也会悄悄变成「当前页合计」，标签却还是「整个视图」。和已修的 #32334（币种版）是同一个问题。
- 这一步做什么：底部合计查询像跳过按行币种金额一样，跳过按行单位数量上的 sum/avg/min/max。
- 要你做的：无。

## What will go wrong
`useWholeSetSummary` (`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/useWholeSetSummary.ts`) builds one ungrouped whole-set query through `compileWholeSetSummaryQuery`. Since #32334 (PR #32492) it leaves out a money aggregate over a `record`-mode currency amount (`recordCurrencyAggregates.ts`: `requiredCurrencyGrouping`, `honestGroupAggregations`; `useColumnSummary` skips record mode). No file under `ui/**` reads `unitConfig`.

PR #36060 (ADR-0158 U7 R1) makes the engine refuse `sum`/`avg`/`min`/`max` over a `number` with `unitConfig: { unitMode: 'record' }` unless grouped by its `unitField` (`INVALID_FIELD` / 400). Once both are on main, a list or grid view with `summary: 'sum'` on such a quantity column sends a query the engine refuses. Every other summarised column in that view then falls back from its whole-set figure to the current page's figure, under a label that reads as the view's total, and grouped views lose their group aggregates the same way. That is #32334's defect on quantities.

reach: a named producer (`compileWholeSetSummaryQuery` sends an ungrouped aggregate for any summarised number column). Read from code, not run: the refusal is not on main until #36060 merges, and `unitConfig` has not shipped in a release yet (changeset `35489-unit-config.md` pending).

## Business reason
A warehouse or purchasing user who adds a Quantity sum to a goods-receipt view, where rows carry KGM, LBR or H87, would read page totals as whole-view totals on every other column, with nothing on screen saying the figures changed meaning.

## Ask
- The whole-set summary and group aggregations leave out `sum`/`avg`/`min`/`max` over a `record`-mode quantity, the way they leave out a record-mode currency amount, so the other columns keep their whole-set figures. A per-unit total grouped by the unit field is a product choice, not part of this card.
- Pins: a view with one record-mode quantity sum and one plain-number sum; the plain column keeps its whole-set figure and no refused request is sent; an ablation each.

## Order
After PR #36060 merges (it adds the refusal). It should land before `unitConfig` ships in a release, so users get both together.

Grading: area:ux · Bug · the unit twin of #32334.
Suggested grade: p2 (wrong totals shown as whole-view totals with no error, on the release that ships units).

Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue useWholeSetSummary` (10 hits, #32334 the currency twin, closed), `whole-set summary record-mode` (#32334, #31912, closed), `unitConfig grid summary` (only the triage seat post) → no card for the quantity case.
